reason: The 'new measurement' is one small in-sample observation, and the finding adds unsupported certainty to it. (1) The 3 'like-for-like' pairs are the same event three times, not 3 replications. The per-clip deltas are identical: 44b6_0113 0, 44b6_0b24 0, 6bba_05b6 -0.00578 (TP -2, FP +3), 6bba_05db -0.00568/-0.00501 (TP -2, FP +5/+6). The whole effect is 13 edge events (TP -4, FP +9) out of ~2,130 GT edges, on 2 in-sample clips. The pooled 'all' -0.0055 is GT-edge weighted and is in effect a 6bba-only number (the clip mean is -0.0029). (2) The 44b6 dummy clips have only 50 and 49 GT edges, so '44b6 unchanged' means unmeasured, not evidence. (3) The 'CI bed +0.0032' it is pooled against is itself optimistic: alpha 0.5 was picked from 7 arms on the same 4 clips (prep_coord_refiner.notes 12:32Z). 'Mixed' is right, but for a different reason than the one given. (4) The finding contradicts itself. Action (3) says the dummy lab gives the wrong sign for CI and must never be read as a sign, yet the same dummy read is the only new input behind lowering P(>=0) from 0.65-0.75 to 0.55-0.65. The revised numbers are therefore not measured either. (5) Action (2) (exp75 = 0.954 -> show A first) contradicts the finding's own 'no change to the partner rule'. It also contradicts its own model: a central +0.0002 is above mc26's break-even (-0.0002 to -0.0004), so B stays favoured. Rule v2 (14:12Z, pre-score) already puts A first when probe 51 reads '-'. Changing a pre-registered display rule on noise-level lab evidence goes against the spirit of R1-R10. (6) Probe 51 (exp87a K+CI vs exp85a K, ref 56640366), read due ~20:50-22:15Z, is a second out-of-embryo CI read on the LB. It will outweigh this lab before the 23:30Z freeze, so fixed card text saying 'one out-of-embryo LB read' would be out of date. Feasibility is trivial (wording only), and the decisions (00:05Z exp89r/exp89q, exp75 at 00:06Z) do not change either way. The real value is a small honesty gain in the card caveat, not a prior revision.
fix: Keep the night, the freeze and EXP75 PARTNER RULE v2 exactly as pre-registered. Drop action (2). Keep action (3) (the dummy lab is not a sign read for coordinate-only changes). At the 23:30Z freeze, write the CI caveat conditional on probe 51: 'CI: LB reads = probe 48 +0.001 (UP 33)[ + probe 51 <code> vs exp85a]. Matched 3D error lower on 7/8 in-sample train clips. Edge-J in-sample is noise-level and mixed: the alpha-selected bed is +0.003 (4 clips, chosen from 7 arms); the unselected dummy is -4 TP/+9 FP out of ~2,130 GT edges on two 6bba clips; the 44b6 dummies are unmeasured (~50 GT edges). Private prior: driven by the LB read(s); the lab does not move it.' Leave the numeric prior (0.65-0.75, central +0.0005) as it stands unless probe 51 reads '-' or '0'. The GAP RULE v2 / partner-rule '-' branch already handles that case.
realistic_gain: About 0 LB/private points. It changes the wording of the finals card only; no file, slot or ordering changes. Risk if action (2) were adopted: it would flip the display order against the model on the exp75 = 0.954 branch.
